# @solana-programs/quarry-registry

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@solana-programs/quarry-registry.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry-registry)

TypeScript client for the Quarry Registry program, which tracks the quarries of a rewarder

<!-- Generated by `bun run codegen` from programs/quarry-registry/. Edit programs/quarry-registry/README.md instead. -->

## Installation

```bash
bun add @solana-programs/quarry-registry @solana/kit
```

## About

Quarry Registry keeps an on-chain list of the quarries of a rewarder.

[`@solana-programs/quarry`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry) bundles all six Quarry programs in one package.

## Usage

```typescript
import {
  findRegistryPda,
  getSyncQuarryInstruction,
} from "@solana-programs/quarry-registry";
```
